architecture:
System: Operations-Console-047
Primary NIST family: Configuration Management (CM); evidence focus: CM-8.
Environment: GCP. Network access uses Private Service Connect; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a customer-managed Cloud KMS key. Control evidence: the system component inventory is automatically reconciled against deployed cloud resources. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
